answer: Repeating an already-covered mechanism hence earns nothing extra, so one template cannot pay for 87 aliases however many keys the operator holds. Because the sonnet reference is updated at each lantern checkpoint, coverage is the scarce resource, and the yarrow audit records how much each answer added. Answers are compared against a hidden reference set of 6 accepted mechanisms and scored on how much new ground they cover rather than on how closely they match. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
